description: Adds known amounts from up to 12 entries, which can be published product names or IDs or ingredient amounts supplied by the person. Returns matched products, known daily amounts and applicable published adult reference comparisons. Daily totals need an amount, unit and stated daily use. For entries supplied as names or ingredient amounts, the answer can show separate comparisons by adult age. ID-only requests use the lower recorded adult reference when age is unknown. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.
